description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creaature with power two or greater.
Capture of Jingzhou's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou trigger, copying it.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Capture of Jingzhous, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.

Call to Mind's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.

Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.

Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.

Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
